_readme: House/self-promo banner ads. Served as-is at GET /ads/promo_banners.json. Edit and push to master; the GitHub webhook restarts the server and picks up changes automatically (see restart_app.sh). These are ONLY shown by the app when a real AdMob/Meta banner request comes back with no fill (never used to replace a filled ad) so it is safe to edit anytime.

_schema.id: unique string, used for click analytics
_schema.enabled: bool, set false to retire an ad without deleting it
_schema.weight: positive number, relative odds of being picked when multiple ads are enabled
_schema.cta_text: short button label, e.g. Open, Install, Visit - shared by all slides
_schema.click_url: absolute https URL opened in the browser/Play Store when the banner is tapped - shared by all slides
_schema.background_color: optional hex color e.g. #0F172A, used behind image/text slides, defaults to the app card color
_schema.text_color: optional hex color e.g. #FFFFFF, defaults to theme text color
_schema.slides: optional array of {image_url, title, description} - if there's more than one, they auto-cycle in place every few seconds and loop back to the first after the last. Each slide can be image-only, text-only (omit image_url), or both. If omitted, put image_url/title/description directly on the ad instead for a single-slide banner.
_schema.slide_interval_seconds: optional number, how long each slide stays before sliding to the next (default 4, clamped to 1-60). Ignored for single-slide ads.
_schema.image_url: single-slide shorthand: absolute https URL to a full banner-shaped creative (e.g. 320x50) - it fills the whole slot, not a small icon. Ignored if slides is present.
_schema.title: single-slide shorthand: short headline, keep under ~40 chars so it fits a banner-sized card. Ignored if slides is present.
_schema.description: single-slide shorthand: optional short subtitle, keep under ~50 chars. Ignored if slides is present.
